niche: a primary care network placing its clinical pharmacist's statin continuity sessions for January to June 2027 at one of seven general practices, read from the practices' repeat statin issue records, their repeat authorisations and the patient register
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms the two clinical systems' issue extracts, rebuilds each patient's statin supply with carryover, fits each practice's persistence on time since the patient started and carries every patient now on a statin forward on that curve sends the pharmacist to Cobbet Street, whose six-issue repeats give it the steepest curve; the golden is Marrick House, whose patients' repeats were re-authorised together in its spring 2026 move to 56-day issues and all run out before March 2027
domain_test: The deciding quantity is a persistence forecast, the medication-adherence-persistence task type's own estimate worked on issue records with carried-forward supply and a gap rule, and what decides it is the repeat authorisation: a prescriber authorises a fixed number of issues, the request after the last one waits for a clinician to re-authorise the repeat, and that is where patients who stop, stop. Swap in another field's nouns and the authorised issue count, the clinician's re-authorisation and a practice moving its repeats to 56-day issues have no counterpart, so the task no longer reads the same

spine.entity: one prescription issue of one drug to one patient

world.geography: England (an unnamed integrated care board area)
world.org_type: a primary care network of seven general practices

driver: The decisive quantity is how many members of each group will have stopped by a date when a member keeps going only through a renewal reached after a fixed run of uses and nearly all stopping happens at a renewal; a curve on time since each member began, or any trailing rate, spreads those losses evenly and ranks the groups by their history, while running each member forward to its own next renewal shows that one group's members were all restarted together a year earlier, so their renewals fall inside the window.
driver_concrete: Statin repeats in the seven practices run on authorisations of a fixed number of issues, and nearly every patient who stops does so when the last issue is used and the repeat waits for a clinician to re-authorise it; Marrick House moved 85 per cent of its repeat patients to 56-day issues in February and March 2026, re-authorising each repeat as six issues, so those repeats run out together in January and February 2027 and Marrick House has the most patients with no statin from March to June 2027, while every persistence curve on time since starting puts Cobbet Street first.
stump: A competent analyst fits each practice's persistence curve on time since starting the statin, carries each patient now on a statin forward on it and sends the pharmacist to Cobbet Street, whose six-issue repeats give it the steepest curve; the losses sit at the end of each repeat authorisation, and Marrick House's spring 2026 move to 56-day issues re-authorised 85 per cent of its patients' repeats at once, so they run out together before March 2027 and Marrick House has the most patients with no statin from March to June.

differentiation.task33: task33 projects a measured elevation's forward yield and truncates it at a filed intervention, recovered by back-testing closed actions against an acceptance bar; nothing here is an elevation or an intervention and no closed action is back-tested: the forward count is each patient run to the end of a recorded repeat authorisation.
differentiation.task41: task41 recovers an unstated eligibility rule from a corpus of determinations (its lineage aggregates a per-person effect under displacement); no rule is recovered and nothing is displaced here: the forecast runs each patient to the end of a recorded authorisation, where stopping happens.
differentiation.task55: task55 finds which date each unit's expiry runs from, an unstated anchoring convention pinned by identity across lots; here the run length is recorded on every authorisation and the step is which clock the stopping hazard runs on, not which date a recorded term counts from.
differentiation.task89: task89 rolls a stock forward against a dated inflow schedule to a first passage through zero; no stock is rolled here: the quantity is a count of patients failing a re-authorisation reached at the end of each patient's own recorded run of issues.
differentiation.task114: task114 counts demand that arises only when two parties share a site on a day; no co-presence or site rule is involved here: the count is of patients whose repeat runs out inside the window and is not re-authorised.
differentiation.task230: task230 forecasts a classification bias in output still to be processed under a looser rule (its lineage a detection rate falling with target rarity); nothing is classified or detected here: the forecast is of patients failing a re-authorisation, timed by each patient's recorded run of issues.

lineage.layer2_pattern: own:concordance by distribution matching, not regression
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many units fall below a cut on a new instrument's scale when part of the population was measured only on the old instrument; a sample measured on both links the scales, and predicting each unit's new value by regression shrinks every converted value toward the sample's mean, so the converted spread is too narrow and the tail beyond the cut too thin, while matching the percentiles of two groups each measured on one instrument assumes the groups are alike; only a conversion that matches the two instruments' distributions in the sample measured on both keeps the share beyond the cut.
lineage.fate: spent on the portal 2026-10-27: both responses landed the call and one filed the runner-up and the gap exactly; the decisive step was the field's own named method for the deciding quantity, so no competent reflex was stopped by it

lineage.layer2_pattern: own:weather-normalized emissions on the current operating regime
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is each unit's output in a standard year of an external driver as the unit now operates, estimated from a response model fitted on the unit's own record; partway through the record many units changed how they respond to the driver or how much they draw regardless of it, on dates no file records, so a model fitted over the whole record or over the latest twelve months, or one recent year scaled by the driver's ratio, misstates the units whose response changed or whose fixed draw does not scale, and each moves a different set of units across the cap.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how much a set of units can deliver in a forward period, and each unit's deliverable positions are fewer than the positions it reports because some of them cannot be worked at the same time, a ceiling no file states and no attestation reflects; the ceiling is fixed exactly by the greatest number of the unit's own timed service intervals that have ever run together, repeated in every period of a long record, so multiplying reported positions by staffed sessions overstates the total and overstates it most at the units whose ceiling is lowest.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is what one funded unit delivers, where the buyer commits the unit before the recipient decides and a refused unit can be passed on only until a fixed calendar date closes the cycle, so the share of funded units ever taken up runs from under a half to nearly all across the candidates; an effect estimated per unit taken up, however cleanly identified from the random rationing, ranks the candidates by their effect on a recipient rather than by what the buyer's committed unit returns.

lineage.niche: an adult education service's withdrawal review: the composition of reasons behind the 2025/26 withdrawals, coded from learners' own free-text exit comments, with the moderation return the service draws each year by reason code (every OT, 400 of each other code)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how a population divides between categories that are only ever observed through a classification that is right at different rates for different categories, so a category whose members describe themselves obliquely is under-counted while the category their words get read as is over-counted; counting the assigned labels ranks the categories by how legible they are rather than by how common they are, and only inverting the per-category hit rates measured on a re-classified sample recovers the division the decision needs.
lineage.driver_concrete: Caring-role withdrawals reach the record as sentences about hours ('nobody to sit with mum on thursday so i cant be there for the start'), so the coding manual's caring-role category is recognised in 68 of 100 cases while work hours clash is recognised in 90 and absorbs the spill. Raw coded counts put work hours clash at 24.5 per cent and caring role at 20.1; carrying the moderation return's split behind each code onto the coded counts puts caring role at 25.4 and work hours clash at 20.2, so the 2027 retention budget targets the other reason.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst counts the coded reasons and commits the 2027 retention budget to work hours clash at 24.5 per cent of withdrawals, because the coded counts measure which reasons the coders recognise rather than which reasons learners had; reweighting the coded counts by what the service's own moderation return measures behind each code puts caring role first at 25.4 per cent against work hours clash at 20.2.
